purpose: Record which prior SCENIC+ artifacts this lane READ and what it TOOK from each, so a reviewer can tell reuse from rediscovery, and so nothing is silently re-derived or silently inherited.
governing_constraint: Stage75F is mechanism/compatibility evidence and hypothesis-generating only. Its motif resources are NOT the authority for this lane, and its TF list is NOT a selection. Every row in every Stage75F table carries validated_regulation=False, validated_grn_claim=False, causal_validation_pass=False and therapeutic_target_claim=False.

artifacts_read.what_this_lane_took: The decisive negative finding. The prior attempt could parse every peak and still could not build a true eGRN, because its RNA and ATAC were not the same nuclei, leaving proximity as the only possible region-to-gene link. This is the documented, prior, EMPIRICAL justification for Route B, and it is cited as such rather than Route B being presented as a precaution.
artifacts_read.action_taken: Built scripts/v69/preflight_routea_region_to_gene_mappability_v1.py to test whether GSE214979's submitted matrix hits the same wall, BEFORE building any network.

artifacts_read.what_this_lane_took: Evidence that the annotation-supply artifact is REAL on this tissue and this motif collection, not hypothetical. Also a scale warning: the prior analysis queried 57-91 regions per TF.

A concrete requirement for control C1. Seven of ten TFs reached support with ZERO direct motifs. A control counting TOTAL motif supply would have been blind to this. C1 therefore separates direct / orthology / similarity AND reports an explicit `extended` category matching this vocabulary, plus a count of extended-only TFs.
artifacts_read.action_taken: scripts/v69/build_tf_annotation_supply_table_v1.py now emits n_distinct_motifs_extended and n_tfs_with_extended_support_but_zero_direct. Measured on the current official v10nr collection: 110 of 1,605 TFs have extended support with zero direct motifs.

what_it_says.edge_claim_language: candidate TF-target coactivity edge; not validated regulation

artifacts_read.what_this_lane_took: Two things. (a) PEAK-TO-GENE from a processed matrix did not work, which is what edge_atac_peak_support_status='not_gene_mappable_from_processed_peak_matrix' records; that remains the Route-B rationale. (b) A prior on donor-level power: the prior edge statistics ran at n=18 donors with Spearman rho and bootstrap sign stability. This lane has 12 donors in its default population, which is LESS, reinforcing the already-frozen expectation that edge-level claims will be unstable while module-level structure may survive.

route_b_rationale_restated_with_prior_ev.old_framing_rejected: Route B as a precautionary sensitivity analysis.
route_b_rationale_restated_with_prior_ev.correct_framing: Route B exists because a prior attempt on this project EMPIRICALLY failed to recover region-to-gene evidence from a processed peak matrix, recording not_gene_mappable_from_processed_peak_matrix on every edge and ready_for_true_scenicplus_egrn=False. Reconstructing the region universe from raw fragments is the documented response to a known, observed failure.
route_b_rationale_restated_with_prior_ev.note_on_the_parallel_lane: This also supersedes the framing in scripts/v64/acquire_gse214979_scenicplus_v1.py on branch chatgpt/v64-privileged-information-recoverability-20260930 at commit 84e10964b0a47d55a33170b1853905b77115d56c, whose receipt calls the fragment route 'an optional sensitivity route'.

measured.same_nucleus_pairing: 2,534 RNA cells and 2,534 ATAC cells on the SAME barcodes

route_a_tested_against_the_prior_failure.why_it_differs_from_stage75f: Stage75F's blocker was the absence of same-cell RNA/ATAC pairing, which left proximity as the only possible link. GSE214979 is a 10x Multiome: both modalities are measured on the same barcode, so region-to-gene can be learned from within-cell covariance rather than proximity.
route_a_tested_against_the_prior_failure.what_this_does_not_claim: It does not claim the resulting network will be good, stable or biologically correct. Only that this specific prior failure mode does not apply.

the_one_real_mapping_defect.defect: mapper used min_overlap_bp=1 instead of pycisTarget's overlap/query_length > 0.4 OR overlap/database_length > 0.4
the_one_real_mapping_defect.consequence: Every published Stage75F number used the CORRECTED 0.4 rule.

actual_limits.scale: 57-91 query regions per TF batch, mapping to 173-286 database regions, against a 219,070-peak universe. ~80 regions cannot resolve TF-specific signal. Single biggest reason only 2 of 11 TFs reached the primary summary.
actual_limits.direct_annotation_supply: 69-81 motifs enriched per TF out of 5,876 tested, but enriched motifs DIRECTLY annotated to the batch TF: BACH1 0, CEBPA 0, MITF 0, NRF1 0, RELA 0, STAT3 0, ELF1 1, SPI1 3.

habits_adopted_from_the_correction: Schema-parity check between the cisTarget scores and rankings databases (the correction added a 32-column parity check after moving the coordinate sidecar between them). Positional indexing means a drifted axis silently mis-assigns every motif without crashing.
Emit an explicit unmapped-regions list so failed queries are visible rather than silently dropped.
